stem: A classroom contains 40 students. 18 of them read Al-Akhbar newspaper, 15 read Al-Ahram newspaper and 8 read both newspapers. A student is selected randomly. Fill in the number of students in each region of the Venn diagram, then find the probability that the student reads Al-Ahram newspaper only.
solution: Reading Al-Ahram only is the event B − A, so the 8 students who read both are removed from B.

hints.text: Some students read neither newspaper. Count everyone in the class who is outside both circles, so the regions add up to the whole class.
Start with the overlap, the students who read both. Then work out how many are left in each circle on its own.

notes: Same diagram as part 1; the answer is read from the B-only region.
